backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT marketplace on ICP, managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minting with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Simple migration module that accepts an old actor state and returns an empty new actor state, effectively discarding the legacy adminPrincipal field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the frontend useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook was updated to match the hardcoded admin Principal in the backend, enabling immediate admin access without a round-trip timeout fallback.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing short summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a build-planning reference for the project's React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light-art portfolio app, set to German language with a Vite module script loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes including gallery, NFT detail, blog, upload, admin dashboard, and wraps everything in a dark-mode ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Error banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing a German-language error message and a retry button that reloads the page.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for admins to create or update NFT collections, using React Query mutations with German-language toast notifications and loading state handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of all NFT collections with edit (via dialog) and delete (via alert dialog) actions, showing loading skeletons and empty state as needed.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit and delete actions including loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, including hover scale and overlay effects.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (checking, online, or unreachable) using the health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, token ID, title, mint date, and truncated owner principal, with an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout wrapping pages with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button), an actor error banner, main content slot, and a footer with backend status.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top navigation bar component that renders nav links, conditionally shows an Admin link only after backend confirms admin status, and provides a retry button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an individual NFT's image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component for an NFT collection that shows a cover image with loading/error states, title, description, and links to the Getgems marketplace.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (Getgems/TON) using NFTCollectionCard, with a heading and description.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT that shows its image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and price, with copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helper functions to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (blue light, red light, wavelengths) with hardcoded content and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes a boolean indicating whether the backend actor is fully initialized, and sets an error state if the actor fails to become ready within a 20-second timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend via getAllCollections() every 60 seconds to determine backend availability, used by a status indicator component.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend addCollection method to create a new NFT collection and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a new NFT via the backend actor and returns the created NFT item, with authorization error parsing and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates collection and NFT item queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for artworks, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still display after the blog backend was replaced.
React Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, combining actor loading state with query loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: React Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via the backend actor's listAllNFTs method, merging actor and query loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor via getAllNFTs, with combined loading state from actor and query.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: A stub React Query hook that always returns null, replacing the old artwork backend with a no-op for the NFT system migration.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: A stub React Query hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-based artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: A stub React Query hook that always returns null for blog posts, deferring to static posts since the old backend was replaced.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend actor, only running when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of NFTs issued by the currently authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, exposing identity, login/logout functions, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin permissions by calling the backend's isCallerAdmin method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status with a timeout, granting immediate access for a hardcoded admin principal and falling back to a backend call for others, exposing a phase-based status and retry function.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related NFT query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the current user profile cache on success.
A stub mutation hook for the contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature is unavailable after the backend migration.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: A stub mutation hook for artwork uploads that always throws an error, replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file uploads to the backend actor with progress tracking, format validation, and error handling, returning an ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines a warm OKLCH-based CSS custom property palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with a timeout, then renders tabbed forms and lists for managing NFT collections and NFT items.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message since the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displays them as clickable cards, and shows a 'New Post' button for admins.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating a new blog post with title, content, and optional featured image upload.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Single blog post detail page that resolves the post by ID from either static data or the backend, then renders the title, date, image, and content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and shows success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page featuring a hero banner, a quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching it by ID from the URL and displaying its image, metadata, collection badge, price, and on-chain explorer link with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page listing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, authentication-gated minting, and modals for detail view and minting.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload/mint page allowing authenticated users to fill out a form with title, description, price, collection, and image file to create a new NFT on-chain with progress feedback.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions to merge static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, find a post by ID from either source, and format timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display by truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of an ICP/Motoko NFT collection management project, including architectural notes, known issues with admin permission checks blocking collection creation, and pending feature requests to hardcode an admin Principal in both the Motoko backend and React frontend.
